ARGUMENTS.NO_DELIMITER: Arguments should start either with --<argname> or -<short argname>
ARGUMENTS.GENERAL: The Raspirus CLI is not stable and subject to change. Automate with caution

ARGUMENT.FULLSCREEN: Will try to force the GUI into fullscreen on launch
ARGUMENT.UPDATE: Attempts to run an update on the local database
ARGUMENT.DEBUG: Enables debug logs; Will ignore config value
ARGUMENT.QUIET: Will surpress any log messages that are not errors
ARGUMENT.SCAN: Will attempt to run a scan on the given path
ARGUMENT.JSON: Will output the scan result in json format
ARGUMENT.THREADS: Maximum number of concurrent threads used for scanning
ARGUMENT.MAX: Maximum number of matches a file can produce
ARGUMENT.MIN: Minimum number of matches a file needs to get flagged
ARGUMENT.REMOTE: Attempts to use given remote to perform the update
